name: grand-to-ground
description: An adversarial, Lakatos-inspired research loop for AI-assisted social science: converge grand frameworks into identifiable, falsifiable questions via parallel deduction, a three-critic tribunal with a severity dial and a recomputing defender, tick-to-approve research plans, and empirical grounding — the human researcher is final arbiter. Field-hardened: every v2 change traces to a logged lesson from a month of live use.
